name: ACF Copilot for WordPress – Advanced Custom Fields LivePreview, Field Search & Code Snippets
author: Krasen Slavov

sections.description:
Transform your Advanced Custom Fields workflow with ACF Copilot – the productivity plugin that adds powerful features Advanced Custom Fields should have built-in.

Stop switching between edit screens and preview windows. ACF Copilot brings LivePreview directly into your Advanced Custom Fields editor, letting you see changes in real-time as you type. Find any field instantly with the keyboard shortcut Ctrl/Cmd + K, access ready-to-use code snippets for WordPress field groups, and speed up development with Bootstrap 5 HTML components.

Whether you’re building custom WordPress themes, managing client sites, or developing complex Advanced Custom Fields architectures, ACF Copilot streamlines every step of your WordPress custom fields workflow.

Why Choose ACF Copilot?

  • LivePreview – See ACF field changes in real-time without leaving the editor
  • Instant Field Search – Find any field across all groups with Ctrl/Cmd+K
  • Code Snippets – Ready-to-use PHP templates for groups, repeaters, and flexible content
  • HTML Components – Bootstrap 5 compatible components for faster frontend development
  • Inline Help – Context-sensitive guidance and tips right where you need them
  • Bulk Management – Delete multiple field groups with one click

How It Works

  1. Install and activate ACF Copilot (requires Advanced Custom Fields plugin)
  2. Edit any ACF field group and enable LivePreview in the metabox
  3. Watch your changes appear in real-time as you add/edit fields
  4. Press Ctrl/Cmd + K to instantly search across all field groups
  5. Access code snippets and HTML components from the ACF Copilot menu

No complex setup required – works immediately with both ACF Free and ACF Pro.

Perfect For

  • WordPress Theme Developers building custom themes with Advanced Custom Fields
  • Agency Developers managing multiple client sites with custom fields
  • Site Builders creating complex Advanced Custom Fields architectures
  • WordPress Freelancers who need to work faster with ACF
  • Content Managers who want visual feedback when setting up custom fields
  • Beginners learning Advanced Custom Fields who need code examples and guidance

Advanced Custom Fields Features

ACF LivePreview for WordPress
See your Advanced Custom Fields changes instantly without switching tabs or refreshing. The preview window updates automatically as you add fields, change labels, or modify settings. Works with WordPress posts, pages, and custom post types (Pro version includes CPT support).

Advanced Custom Fields Search Tool
Press Ctrl/Cmd+K anywhere in the WordPress admin to open the field search modal. Search across all Advanced Custom Fields field groups by field name, label, or type. Click to jump directly to the field group editor – no more hunting through dozens of ACF field groups.

ACF Code Snippets Library
Access production-ready PHP code for displaying Advanced Custom Fields groups, repeaters, and flexible content. Copy and paste directly into your WordPress theme files with proper escaping and WordPress best practices already applied.

HTML Components for WordPress
Choose from Base HTML or Bootstrap 5 components for common Advanced Custom Fields display patterns. Includes cards, tables, lists, grids, and more – all optimized for ACF field output in WordPress themes.

Bulk Field Group Management
Select multiple Advanced Custom Fields field groups and delete them all at once. Perfect for cleaning up test fields, removing old architectures, or managing large ACF installations in WordPress.

Inline Help System
Get context-sensitive help and tips directly in the WordPress admin. Learn Advanced Custom Fields best practices, discover new features, and troubleshoot issues without leaving your workflow.

Usage

Once the plugin is installed and activated:

  1. Navigate to ACF Copilot in the WordPress admin menu
  2. Explore the Code Snippets library for field display templates
  3. Browse HTML Components for Bootstrap 5 frontend patterns
  4. Enable LivePreview when editing any ACF field group

Here are the steps to use ACF Copilot:

  1. Edit any ACF field group
  2. Look for the ACF Copilot LivePreview metabox
  3. Click to enable preview and select your preview post/page
  4. Add or modify fields and watch the preview update in real-time
  5. Press Ctrl/Cmd + K anytime to search all fields
  6. Use bulk actions to delete multiple field groups at once

Note: LivePreview for custom post types, Block Editor support, and AI-powered features are Pro-only.

Using LivePreview

In Classic Editor:
1. Edit any post or page with ACF fields
2. Open the ACF Copilot LivePreview metabox
3. Click the preview toggle to enable
4. Changes appear automatically as you edit fields

In Block Editor (Pro):
LivePreview works seamlessly with Gutenberg, updating in real-time as you modify field groups. The preview sidebar shows exactly how fields will appear on your site.

Using Field Search

  1. Press Ctrl/Cmd + K (or click Search Fields button)
  2. Type any part of a field name, label, or type
  3. Results appear instantly across all field groups
  4. Click any result to jump to that field group editor
  5. Close with ESC or click outside the modal

Using Code Snippets

  1. Go to ACF Copilot > Code Snippets
  2. Browse categories: Field Groups, Repeaters, Flexible Content
  3. Click any snippet to view the code
  4. Copy and paste into your theme files
  5. Customize variable names and field keys as needed

Features & Limitations

The ACF Copilot plugin allows you to:

  • Preview ACF field changes in real-time with LivePreview (Classic Editor)
  • Search all fields instantly with keyboard shortcut Ctrl/Cmd + K
  • Access production-ready PHP code snippets for field groups and repeaters
  • Use Bootstrap 5 HTML components for faster frontend development
  • Get inline help and tooltips for ACF best practices
  • Bulk delete field groups to clean up your ACF installation
  • View context-sensitive documentation without leaving WordPress

Core Features

LivePreview
Real-time preview of ACF field changes as you edit field groups. See exactly how fields will appear on posts and pages without switching tabs. The free version supports Classic Editor on posts and pages.

Field Search
Lightning-fast search across all ACF field groups with Ctrl/Cmd+K keyboard shortcut. Find fields by name, label, type, or group. Results update instantly as you type.

Code Snippets
Copy-paste ready PHP code for displaying field groups, repeaters, and flexible content. All code follows WordPress Coding Standards with proper escaping and sanitization.

HTML Components
Pre-built Bootstrap 5 and Base HTML templates for common ACF display patterns. Includes cards, tables, accordions, tabs, grids, and more.

Bulk Management
Select and delete multiple field groups at once. Clean up test fields, remove old projects, or reorganize your ACF architecture efficiently.

Known Limitations

Free version limitations:

  • LivePreview – Classic Editor only (posts and pages). Pro adds Block Editor and CPT support.
  • Code Snippets – Basic field groups and repeaters only. Pro adds flexible content and complex queries.
  • HTML Components – Base HTML and Bootstrap 5. Pro adds custom component builder.
  • AI Features – Not available in free version. Pro includes AI field group generator.
  • Custom Post Types – LivePreview limited to posts/pages. Pro supports all CPTs.
  • Database Cleaner – Not included. Pro adds unused custom fields cleanup tool.
  • Priority Support – Community support only. Pro includes priority email support.

Detailed Documentation

Find step-by-step setup guides, video tutorials, code examples, and advanced usage tips on the ACF Copilot Documentation page.

ACF Copilot Pro

If you’re using the free version from WordPress.org and want Pro features, you can purchase the premium version on the ACF Copilot Pro website.

Here are some features included in the Pro version:

  • AI Field Group Generator – Describe your fields in plain English, get complete field groups instantly
  • Block Editor LivePreview – Real-time preview in Gutenberg with full sidebar integration
  • Custom Post Type Support – LivePreview works with all registered CPTs and taxonomies
  • Advanced Code Snippets – Flexible content, complex queries, custom functions, and API integrations
  • Custom Component Builder – Create and save your own HTML component templates
  • Database Cleanup Tool – Find and remove unused custom field meta from your database
  • Bulk Export/Import – Export field groups as JSON with one click, import across sites
  • Field Group Analytics – See which fields are actually being used on your site
  • Priority Email Support – Direct access to developers with 24-hour response time
  • Regular Updates – Early access to new features and improvements
  • Multisite Support – Network-wide features and per-site configurations
  • Developer API – Extend ACF Copilot with custom add-ons and integrations
sections.installation:
The plugin installation is easy and straightforward. Let us know if you run into any issues.

Requirements:
– WordPress 5.0 or higher
– PHP 7.2 or higher
– Advanced Custom Fields (Free or Pro)

Installation from WordPress

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New
  2. Search for ACF Copilot
  3. Click Install Now then Activate
  4. Navigate to ACF Copilot in the admin menu

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Upload the acf-copilot folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  3. Go to Plugins in WordPress admin
  4. Activate ACF Copilot
  5. Navigate to ACF Copilot in the admin menu

After Activation

  1. Click the ACF Copilot menu item in WordPress admin
  2. Browse Code Snippets to see available templates
  3. Check out HTML Components for frontend patterns
  4. Edit any ACF field group to enable LivePreview
  5. Press Ctrl/Cmd + K to try the field search feature
  6. Visit Settings to customize plugin options

Quick Start:
1. Edit any post or page with ACF fields
2. Enable LivePreview in the metabox
3. Start adding/editing fields and watch the magic happen!
sections.faq:
Visit the Support Forum to share your questions or requests.

We usually respond to tickets within a few days.

Feature requests are added to our wish list and considered for future updates.

Does this require Advanced Custom Fields?

Yes, ACF Copilot is an add-on for Advanced Custom Fields. You must have either ACF Free or ACF Pro installed and activated. The plugin works with both versions.

Is ACF Copilot compatible with all field groups?

Yes, ACF Copilot supports all field groups created with Advanced Custom Fields, including complex field types like repeaters, flexible content, and clone fields. Some advanced features (AI generation, flexible content snippets) require the Pro version.

Will the plugin modify my existing ACF fields?

No, ACF Copilot does not modify your existing fields or data. It enhances your workflow with tools like LivePreview, search, and code snippets. Your original field groups remain completely unchanged.

Does LivePreview work with the Block Editor?

In the free version, LivePreview supports the Classic Editor only. In the Pro version, LivePreview works with both Classic and Block (Gutenberg) editors, with full sidebar integration and real-time updates.

Can I use this with custom post types?

Yes, but with limitations. Field Search and Code Snippets work with all post types. LivePreview for custom post types requires ACF Copilot Pro.

Do I need coding skills to use ACF Copilot?

Not at all! The plugin is beginner-friendly. LivePreview and Field Search require zero coding knowledge. Code Snippets provide copy-paste templates even if you’re new to PHP. HTML Components give you ready-to-use frontend code.

What’s the difference between free and Pro?

The free version includes LivePreview (Classic Editor), Field Search, basic code snippets, HTML components, and bulk delete. The Pro version adds AI field generation, Block Editor support, CPT LivePreview, advanced snippets, database cleanup, and priority support.

Can I use ACF Copilot with WordPress Multisite?

The free version works on multisite but without network-level features. ACF Copilot Pro includes full multisite support with network admin controls and per-site configurations.

Does it work with ACF Pro’s flexible content?

Yes, Field Search works with flexible content fields. Code snippets for flexible content layouts are available in ACF Copilot Pro.

Will this slow down my WordPress admin?

No, ACF Copilot loads only on relevant admin screens and uses efficient code. The plugin is optimized for performance with minimal database queries and conditional asset loading.

How does the AI Field Group Generator work? (Pro)

Describe your fields in plain English: “Create a team member with name, photo, bio, and social links.” The AI generates a complete field group with proper field types, settings, and organization – ready to use immediately.

Do you provide support for the free version?

Yes, community support is available through the WordPress.org support forum. Response times are typically 24-48 hours. ACF Copilot Pro includes priority email support with same-day responses.

How do I preview ACF fields in WordPress?

Enable LivePreview in the ACF Copilot metabox when editing any field group. The preview window shows real-time changes as you add or modify Advanced Custom Fields without leaving the editor.

What’s the best ACF field manager plugin?

ACF Copilot provides comprehensive field management tools including instant field search (Ctrl/Cmd+K), bulk field group delete, and LivePreview – making it easier to manage hundreds of Advanced Custom Fields efficiently.

How to search Advanced Custom Fields quickly?

Press Ctrl/Cmd + K anywhere in WordPress admin to open the field search modal. Search across all ACF field groups by name, label, or type. Click any result to jump directly to that field group.

Does this work with ACF Pro and ACF Free?

Yes, ACF Copilot works with both Advanced Custom Fields Free and ACF Pro. All core features (LivePreview, Field Search, Code Snippets, Bulk Management) are compatible with either version.

How to get ACF code snippets for WordPress themes?

Navigate to ACF Copilot > Code Snippets in your WordPress admin. Browse categories for field groups, repeaters, and flexible content. Copy production-ready PHP code with proper escaping and WordPress Coding Standards.

What’s the best way to manage multiple ACF field groups?

Use ACF Copilot’s bulk management tools to select and delete multiple field groups at once. The Field Search feature (Ctrl/Cmd+K) helps you quickly find and navigate between field groups in large ACF installations.

How to speed up Advanced Custom Fields development?

ACF Copilot speeds up development with LivePreview (see changes in real-time), instant field search, ready-to-use code snippets, Bootstrap 5 HTML components, and bulk field group management tools.

Can I preview custom fields in Gutenberg?

Yes, with ACF Copilot Pro. The Pro version includes full Block Editor (Gutenberg) support with real-time LivePreview updates. The free version supports Classic Editor only.

How to bulk delete ACF field groups?

Select multiple field groups using checkboxes in the ACF field groups list, then use the bulk delete action. Perfect for cleaning up test fields or removing old Advanced Custom Fields architectures.

What are the best ACF productivity tools?

ACF Copilot provides essential productivity tools: real-time LivePreview, instant field search (Ctrl/Cmd+K), production-ready code snippets, Bootstrap 5 components, inline help, and bulk field group management.

How does ACF LivePreview work with WordPress?

ACF LivePreview creates a live preview window alongside your field group editor. As you add, remove, or modify Advanced Custom Fields, the preview updates automatically showing exactly how fields appear on your WordPress site.
sections.changelog:
1.1.2

Security Enhancements

  • Security – Fixed CSRF vulnerability in settings reset with proper nonce and capability verification
  • Security – Fixed unescaped output in custom help tabs using wp_kses_post() escaping
  • Security – Removed insecure file_get_contents() fallbacks in code snippets and HTML components
  • Security – Added nonce verification and capability checks to WP Pointer AJAX dismissal

Code Quality Improvements

  • Fix – Replaced loose comparisons (!=) with strict comparisons (!==) for WPCS compliance
  • Improve – Updated all file-level DocBlocks with proper descriptions and @since tags (31 files)
  • Improve – Added comprehensive inline documentation for all classes and methods
  • Improve – Localized all JavaScript strings (alerts, confirms, messages) via wp_localize_script()
  • Improve – Made all PHP and JavaScript strings fully translation-ready

Standards Compliance

  • Update – WordPress Coding Standards (WPCS) compliance across entire codebase
  • Update – Removed all phpcs:ignore comments after fixing underlying issues
  • Update – Production-ready with comprehensive security audit completed

1.1.1

  • Update – Compatibility and maintenance release
  • Update – Tested with WordPress 6.8
  • Update – Tested with ACF 6.4

1.1.0

New Features

  • New – Field Search: Instantly find any ACF field with Ctrl/Cmd+K keyboard shortcut
  • New – Search Fields button in toolbar for mouse users
  • New – LivePreview auto-refresh after clicking Update/Publish
  • New – Welcome onboarding notice for first-time users
  • New – WP Pointer highlighting main menu on activation

LivePreview Improvements

  • Update – Complete rewrite with modern architecture
  • Update – Now works with both Classic and Block (Gutenberg) editors
  • Update – Event-driven updates instead of polling
  • Update – 2-second debouncing for better performance
  • Update – Visual syncing indicator shows when preview is updating
  • Update – Better error handling with user-friendly messages
  • Update – Step-by-step usage guide in LivePreview metabox

Bug Fixes

  • Fix – HTML Components AJAX handler now works correctly
  • Fix – Component path mapping fixed for all component types
  • Fix – Nonce verification added to all component requests
  • Fix – Bulk Delete CSS disables ACF native drag handles when checkboxes selected

Removed Features

  • Remove – Bulk Drag & Drop (conflicted with ACF native functionality)

Performance

  • Improve – Better code organization and file structure
  • Improve – Updated documentation throughout
  • Improve – Various performance optimizations

1.0.5

  • Fix – Added proper sanitization for register_setting()
  • Fix – Stricter nonce verification using check_admin_referer() and check_ajax_referer()
  • Fix – Added capability checks (manage_options) before all admin actions
  • Fix – Ensured unauthorized users cannot bypass dismissals or settings updates
  • Update – Removed deprecated load_plugin_textdomain() function

1.0.4

  • Update – Removed bitly.com links, replaced with direct analytics-tracked URLs
  • Fix – Notice translation loading for ‘acf-copilot’ domain triggered too early

1.0.3

  • Update – Compatibility tested with WordPress 6.8
  • Update – Compatibility tested with ACF 6.4
  • Fix – Minor styling inconsistencies

1.0.2

  • New – Hide setting notices after save for cleaner UI
  • Update – Performance and optimization improvements
  • Update – Code quality enhancements across all files
  • Update – Updated copyright year 2024 to 2025
  • Fix – Minor JavaScript and CSS fixes

1.0.1

  • New – Added Pro vs Free comparison table under Settings
  • Update – Development environment and build system updates
  • Fix – Sanitized all database fields
  • Fix – Replaced json_encode() with wp_json_encode()
  • Fix – Replaced file_get_contents() with wp_remote_get() for remote files

1.0.0

  • New – Initial public release
  • New – LivePreview for ACF field groups (Classic Editor)
  • New – Code Snippets library with field group templates
  • New – HTML Components (Base HTML and Bootstrap 5)
  • New – Bulk field group delete functionality
  • New – Inline help system with tooltips
  • New – Settings page with plugin options

Full changelog available at ACF Copilot
